command.rovenfall.help.header: Rovenfall Player Help — use Tab to complete IDs and arguments.
command.rovenfall.help.shop: /rovenfall shop info|buy|sell — inspect and trade with a nearby bound administrator shop.
command.rovenfall.help.portal: /rovenfall portal [portal_id] — use a nearby portal and arrive at a validated safe location.
command.rovenfall.help.claim: /rovenfall claim explain|buy|info|trust|untrust|settings|transfer|sell — manage the current Hub chunk.
command.rovenfall.help.activity: /rovenfall activity — view all seven permanent activity tracks and levels.
command.rovenfall.help.challenge: /rovenfall challenge list|info|claim — inspect and claim one-time activity goals.
command.rovenfall.help.contract: /rovenfall contract list|info|claim — complete repeatable daily Wilderness contracts.
command.rovenfall.help.expedition: /rovenfall expedition list|info|claim — complete weekly goals across daily contracts.
command.rovenfall.help.career: /rovenfall career info|explain|promote — inspect requirements before confirming a career promotion.
command.rovenfall.help.skill: /rovenfall skill info|explain|unlock|reset|slots|equip|clear|use — manage passive and active skills.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.search: /rovenfall admin search <scope> <page> <query> — search players, balances, transactions, claims, shops, denials, or alerts; use * for all.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.audit: /rovenfall admin audit list|gui [page] — inspect the authoritative audit trail.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.roles: /rovenfall admin role set — owners assign viewer, moderator, economy, content, or owner authority.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.economy: /rovenfall admin economy grant|debit|view|reverse — manage balances and exact shop-trade compensation.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.shops: /rovenfall admin shop — create, bind, configure access, offers, and restocking.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.worlds: /rovenfall admin portal|boss — manage protected travel endpoints and Wilderness boss encounters.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.claims: /rovenfall admin claim — inspect or correct current-chunk trust and protection settings.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.reverse: /rovenfall admin reverse <original_uuid> <reversal_uuid> <reason> — safely reverse claim, permission, shop, career, or skill changes; reverse newest dependencies first.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.snapshot: /rovenfall admin snapshot create|restore — create a safety point or perform an owner-only full restore.
command.rovenfall.admin.help.destructive: /rovenfall admin wilderness reset confirm <reason> — schedules evacuation, backup, reset, and verification; check status before retrying.
